N2uCore.dyn.eyegaze.GazeDirection.label: Gaze Direction
N2uCore.dyn.eyegaze.GazeDirection.description: RGB face to gaze yaw/pitch, landmark-derived head roll and unit 3D gaze vector. Fixed GazeDINO model, automatic or CPU compute device and configurable maximum inference FPS.

N2uCore.dyn.screenpointofgaze.ScreenPoin.label: Screen Point of Gaze
N2uCore.dyn.screenpointofgaze.ScreenPoin.description: Maps upstream gaze direction to screen pixels after session-only guided calibration. No saved calibration files or neural model.
